parameters.content:
## Review decision
The screen posts approve / save / reject. Corrections are re-validated with the **same rules** as the intake; an approval that still fails validation is refused (HTTP 422). Every change is written to the audit log with before/after.

parameters.query: select d.*, (select coalesce(json_agg(e.supplier_vat_id || '|' || e.invoice_number), '[]'::json) from erp_invoices e where e.document_id <> d.id) as existing_keys from documents d where d.id = $1::uuid

with u as (update documents set status = 'needs_review', reasons = reasons || jsonb_build_array('Reopened by ' || $2 || coalesce(': ' || $3, '')) where id = $1::uuid and status = 'rejected' returning id), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) select $2, 'reopened', u.id, $3 from u returning id) select 'reopened' as status, 'Reopened.' as message

with u as (update documents set status = 'rejected', reasons = reasons || jsonb_build_array('Rejected by ' || $2 || ': ' || coalesce($3, 'no reason given')) where id = $1::uuid returning id), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) select $2, 'rejected', u.id, $3 from u returning id) select 'rejected' as status, 'Rejected.' as message

with u as (update documents set doc_type = $2::doc_type, supplier_name = $3, supplier_vat_id = $4, supplier_country = $5, invoice_number = $6, invoice_date = $7::date, due_date = $8::date, currency = $9, po_number = $10, net_amount = $11, vat_rate = $12, vat_amount = $13, gross_amount = $14, related_invoice = $15, reasons = $16::jsonb, warnings = $17::jsonb, status = $18::doc_status where id = $1::uuid returning id, status) insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, before, after, note) select $19, $20, u.id, $21::jsonb, $22::jsonb, $23 from u returning document_id as id, (select status from u) as status

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.before.id, $json.normalized.doc_type, $json.normalized.supplier_name, $json.normalized.supplier_vat_id, $json.normalized.supplier_country, $json.normalized.invoice_number, $json.normalized.invoice_date, $json.normalized.due_date, $json.normalized.currency, $json.normalized.po_number, $json.normalized.net_amount, $json.normalized.vat_rate, $json.normalized.vat_amount, $json.normalized.gross_amount, $json.normalized.related_invoice, JSON.stringify($json.reasons), JSON.stringify($json.warnings), 'needs_review', $json.actor, 'corrected', JSON.stringify((({ supplier_name, supplier_vat_id, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, currency, po_number, net_amount, vat_rate, vat_amount, gross_amount, status }) => ({ supplier_name, supplier_vat_id, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, currency, po_number, net_amount, vat_rate, vat_amount, gross_amount, status }))($json.before)), JSON.stringify($json.normalized), 'Fields corrected; still open.' ] }}

All checks pass.' ] }}
